basic_info.description: Experience comfortable living at 290 Munich Street! This spacious home boasts an updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a separate dining room featuring access to the yard that extends your living space outdoors, and a naturally bright living room. With two bedrooms and a large bathroom upstairs, and a family room, bedroom, and second bath downstairs, there's space for everyone. Enjoy the convenience of a one-car garage with an automatic door opener and a large yard for outdoor enjoyment. A separate entrance for the downstairs allows for flexible use. Just two blocks away, McLaren Park awaits, offering an incredible range of outdoor activities. Enjoy scenic hiking and walking trails, dedicated dog runs, a tranquil lake, tennis, pickleball, basketball, soccer, baseball, a bike park, and a 9-hole golf course, all complemented by inviting picnic areas. Conveniently close to neighborhood shopping and one block away from public transportation, this home combines comfortable living with a highly functional layout in the Excelsior.
